findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Philippine Marketplace" above "Shop independent sellers."; "Participant 01 · Buyers" above "Find products. Follow your orders."; "Participant 02 · Sellers" above "Run your shop."; "Participant 03 · Logistics Hubs" above "Plan pickups and deliveries"; "The Marketplace Cycle" above "From shop to doorstep"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace — e.g. "aisley.app · storefront", "aisley.app · buyer workspace", "seller.aisley.app · workspace", "logistics.aisley.app · hub console"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 14 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Philippine Marketplace", "Participant 01 · Buyers", "Participant 02 · Sellers", "Participant 03 · Logistics Hubs").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 12 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.inline-flex.items-center → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | figure.product-shot → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 1px 2px 0px | a.inline-flex.items-center → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 24 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.sticky.top-0 1280px | div.flex.items-start 512px | div.preview-chrome 460px | a.preview-image 460px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 96 characters per line.

findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 56px (4.4vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: Only 0 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.
